dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Colada, a playful sweetheart who’s never too busy for a belly rub!

Colada loves a good game of chase in the yard, but don’t be surprised when she comes running right back to you for a belly rub! Once she’s gotten some affection, she’s ready to race off and start the fun all over again.

This gentle girl also loves toys and enjoys running, wrestling and playing with familiar dog friends. When playtime winds down, Colada is happy to stick close by, crawl into your lap for some pets or settle in with a favorite toy.

Whether you’re ready to play or looking for a cuddle buddy, Colada would love to spend some time getting to know you. Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Colada’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: COLADA
